title: Practice 5: Someone who does or is something

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **продавец** — seller, salesman, vendor. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «-ец», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ец).
**продавец** — продавец: seller, salesman, vendor; shop assistant (shop employee). Wiktionary: продава́ть + -е́ц.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **корми́лец** — breadwinner, supporter (of the family). Source: Russian Wiktionary, «-ец», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ец).

exercises.q: Tom is the breadwinner in this family.
exercises.why: **кормилец** — корми́лец: breadwinner, supporter (of the family). Wiktionary: корми́ть + -лец.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: I'm the owner of the house.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Tom is a dead man walking.
exercises.why: **мертвец** — мертвец: corpse, cadaver, dead man, dead body.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: певец — singer; продавец — seller, salesman, vendor; корми́лец — breadwinner, supporter (of the family); владе́лец — owner.
**загово́рщик** — conspirator, plotter. Source: Wiktionary, «-щик» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-щик#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: I think that Tom is a part of the conspiracy.
exercises.ru: Я думаю, что Том — один из ___.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.
